sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 25908 of 2023
Applicant :- Lokendra @ Lokendra Singh

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Digvijay Singh,Sudhir Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Gajendra Kumar,J.
Heard counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed to quash the non-bailable warrant order dated 01.03.2023 passed by Court, ADJ/ Special Judge (POCSO Act) Bijnor as well as the entire proceeding of S.T. No.46 of 2018 (State vs. Dauid and others) in connection with case crime no.512 of 2017, under sections 363, 366, 370, 376/34 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, P.S. Nehtaur,
District Bijnor.
The only submission raised by learned counsel for the applicant is that the court concerned vide order dated 01.03.2023 has issued non-bailable warrant for appearance of the applicant.
Counsel for the applicant has urged that an opportunity be granted to the applicant to file an application for recall of the order issuing non-bailable warrant.
Lokendra @ Lokendra Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/136015517/

entities.text: Lokendra @ Lokendra Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 Learned AGA has no objection to the said prayer.
The prayer for quashing the entire proceeding of aforesaid criminal case is hereby refused.

However, it is provided that if the applicant files an application for recall of the order issuing non-bailable warrant within two weeks from today, the said application shall be considered by the court concerned and appropriate order shall be passed expeditiously.
For a period of two weeks, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.
In the event of failure, on the part of the applicant to act within time as directed above, the court concerned may adopt all coercive measures to ensure the appearance.
With the aforesaid observations, this application is finally disposed of.
Order Date :- 20.7.2023
